tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dngos// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das// 'khor lo sdom pa la btud de// dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus bshad// 'khor lo gsum rim rnal 'byor nyid// gang gis khams gsum sems can rnams// rdo rje 'chang gi gnas thob pa'i// dbang bskur cho ga'i rim pa bshad// dbang bskur dkyil 'khor sngon 'gro bar// rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs pa ste// 'on kyang dkyil 'khor de'i rang bzhin// ci yin de ni 'di ltar bshad// ri mor gnas pa'i las dang ni// thig la tshon dbye'i rim pa bstan// 'gro ba 'di dag rang bzhin gyis// grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis med pa'o// bcos ma gnyis kyi ngo bo gang*// de ni gdul bya'i dbang las 'dod// mkhas pas bsgrub bya de min te// yang dag don mthong grol phyir ro// 'khor lo gsum gyi dkyil 'khor grub// dkyil 'khor lha rnams grub pa'o// de yi dbang bskur la sogs rim// ci nas ma grub yang grub byed// de yi rang bzhin mi shes rnams// snod du bya bar bzhed pa ste// dbang bskur sogs rim kun rdzob tu// tha snyad du yang grub pa'o// slob dpon la sogs dbye ba yis// dbang bskur rnam pa bzhir bshad de// chu yi dbang sogs dbye ba yis// bzhi po de ni bcu bzhi'o// de'ang lnga ste/ dbang bskur gyi sngon du 'gro ba'i 'thad pa/ gang du 'jug pa'i yul dkyil 'khor gyi rab tu dbye ba/ bcos ma gnyis spangs te rang bzhin gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i tshul/ don dam par spros pa las grol yang kun rdzob tu dbang bskur ba'i 'thad pa/ dbang gi dbye ba spyir bstan pa'o// bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis// dang por bdag gi rnal 'byor bya// sngags sogs kyis mchod gtor ma sbyin// bum pa'i cho ga legs byas la// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams mchod// spyi yi rnam gzhag sngon 'gro bas// maṇḍal phul la bden pa brjod// gdong g.yogs bcings la me tog gtad// bsrung zhing byin rlabs 'dod pa dri// byang sems bskyed de gsang bar gdams// nang du bcug la gsol ba gdab// dam tshig bsgrags pa thun mong dang*// khyad par gyi ni sdom pa sbyin// legs sbyangs dngos gzhi'i cho ga bya// dam la bzhag cing ye shes dbab// me tog dor la dkyil 'khor bstan// 'jug pa yi ni cho ga 'o// dbang gi don du gsol ba gdab// dbang bskur rnam pa bcu bzhi yis// de nas dbang ni bskur bar bya// sngags dang chu dang cod paṇa dang*// rdo rje dril bu ming gi dbang*// brtul bzhugs gnyis dang lung bstan dang*// slob dpon dbang dang rjes gnang dang*// gsang ba shes rab ye shes dang*// bzhi pa yang ni de bzhin no// slob dpon la sogs bzhi po yang*// sngon 'gro dngos gzhi mjug gi las// gsum gsum gyis ni yang dag bsdus// gzhan don bya ba'i rim pa'o// rang gis dam tshig gso 'dod na// mdun du dkyil 'khor bsgrubs la mchod// slob dpon gyi ni cho ga rnams// dkyil 'khor gtso bos mdzad par bsam// cho ga'i go rim sngar dang mtshungs// rjes kyi bya ba gzhan dang 'dra// 'on kyang gtor mgron ma gtogs pa// gzhan ni gshegs su gsol ba med// lus la dkyil 'khor la brten phyir// dbang gi bya ba mdor bsdus pa'o// zab mo'i rgyud la brten nas ni// rnal 'byor dbang phyug dril bu pas// dbang bskur cho ga'i rim pa mdzad// de yi mdor bsdus bdag gis sbyar// de las byung ba'i dge ba des// 'gro kun lam mchog 'dir zhugs nas// sgrib pa'i dri ma kun spangs te// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog
/lus kyi dkyil 'khor la brten te dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mdor bsdus 'phags pa'i ming dang ldan pas sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
